page.notes: The first word of the page, "siduum", is uncertain: the initial letter is an f-like long s, read here as s. The Greek "λογιςῶν" is doubtful and read from a small, rubbed impression. The page number "192" is partly obscured by a decorative mark. The lower left of the page is stained and damaged, but no text is lost there. The body text is set in italic type.
